item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"8c884119d7ab95eb9234-1","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"本段介紹 SMB 管理、認證與資料庫工具，未提供離線雜湊破解功能或流程。","evidence":"smbpasswd The Samba encrypted password file Change a user’s SMB password"},{"decision_id":"533e21b76b9ca2e7d6f7-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"明確提供 WPA/WPA2 用戶端握手自動擷取功能。","evidence":"WiFi networks scanning, deauthentication attack, clientless PMKID association attack and automatic WPA/WPA2 client handshakes capture."},{"decision_id":"7101b1bf171ed45004b0-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"DNS 功能是中間人攻擊用的偽造，未記載 DNS 紀錄查詢、子網域探索或列舉能力。","evidence":"ARP, DNS, NDP and DHCPv6 spoofers for MITM attacks on IPv4 and IPv6 based networks."},{"decision_id":"8b6b0c832a4e5fa43763-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"說明以 -O 啟用遠端作業系統偵測，並將探測回應與指紋資料庫比對。","evidence":"The nmap-os-db OS database is consulted when remote OS detection is requested with the -O option."},{"decision_id":"42f63a8e1044dfef6e57-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"明確提供遞迴與逐層深度掃描，可探索巢狀網站目錄。","evidence":"-r, --recursive Brute-force recursively --deep-recursive Perform recursive scan on every directory depth (e.g. api/users -> api/)"}]}
